name: China Medical System Holdings Limited
summary: China Medical System Holdings Limited is an investment holding company established in 1995 and based in North Point, Hong Kong. It develops, markets and distributes a broad pharmaceutical range in China, covering cardiovascular, neurological and mental health, digestive and liver, eye, bone, skin, respiratory and infectious disease treatments. Products named in its portfolio include Plendil, Imdur, Deanxit, Ursofalk, Salofalk and Lamisil.
